notes: New families start simpler: one Home screen of widgets that need no setting up (weather, today & tomorrow, notes, a list, birthdays, kitchen timer, news, a quote) and a Calendar screen. A Children screen appears by itself when someone joins the reward system, and goes again if no one is. Other widgets – traffic, trains, bins, photos… – are added from Screens, where each asks for what it needs. Existing dashboards are not changed.
Setup: the licence step shows an amber ½ whenever you carry on without a key (the free trial) – in the step list and on the Done page.
